name: entscheidsuche
title: entscheidsuche-mcp
description: MCP server for Swiss court decisions and case law provided by entscheidsuche.ch. AI search by meaning (semantic search) and keyword search over decisions of the Federal Supreme Court (BGer, BGE) and cantonal courts in German, French and Italian.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search Swiss case law (default)
tools.description: Default search: AI search by meaning for questions in natural language; switches to keyword search for case numbers, phrases and Boolean queries.

tools.name: semantic_search
tools.title: AI search by meaning (semantic search)
tools.description: Embedding-based search for legal questions and descriptions of facts, across German, French and Italian decisions.

tools.name: keyword_search
tools.title: Keyword search (exact terms)
tools.description: Full-text search for exact words, phrases and Boolean expressions with filters, sorting and pagination.

tools.name: search_by_case_number
tools.title: Search by case number
tools.description: Exact lookup of Swiss case numbers, docket references and BGE citations.

tools.name: fetch_document
tools.title: Fetch decision (full text)
tools.description: Retrieve a single decision together with its full text.

tools.name: list_hierarchy
tools.title: List courts with decision counts
tools.description: Hierarchy IDs of cantons, courts and chambers with decision counts.

tools.name: list_facets
tools.title: Court tree with names
tools.description: Tree of cantons, courts and chambers with names in German, French and Italian.

tools.name: server_info
tools.title: Server info
tools.description: Version and endpoint information for this server.
